title: A layer that opens over another popover must not close it
rule: When a menu or panel can open on top of an open UiPopover (a context menu on a field inside a picker, a confirm inside a popover), render it as a UiPopover with `over`: a press inside an `over` layer does not count as an outside press for the other open layers, and it stacks above them. Every open UiPopover closes on any document pointerdown outside its own layer and anchor, so without it the host popover closes (and moves the focus) before the top layer's click runs, and the action runs on nothing. Test it with a component test that mounts a host UiPopover with the field inside, dispatches pointerdown and click on the top layer's item and asserts the host stays open and the action ran, and a Playwright step on a real nested case; check that both fail without `over`.
rationale: E54.2 (#612): the text fields' menu was a separate UiPopover; in the foundry picker's search field a click on Copy closed the picker first, the field blurred, the menu closed and nothing was copied. Only the keyboard path worked.
